scope: current delivery version normal navigation matrix; user#521 functional policy, fault work excluded#547; no changed numeric gates

arrival_position_yaw_dwell.method: One fixed scale-one prestream SE(3); compare the same IMU reference point; simultaneously satisfy position and yaw on contiguous simulation source time; no interpolation credit for dwell.

raw_vio_absolute_error.method: N13 diagnostic only; neither numeric breaches nor missing diagnostic coverage determine functional PASS/FAIL. Historical measurement method: N01 absolute error under the same fixed prestream alignment; show each segment and source-gap support; no segment fit.

raw_vio_rpe_10s.method: N13 diagnostic only; neither numeric breaches nor missing diagnostic coverage determine functional PASS/FAIL. Historical measurement method: N01 relative-pose calculation at exact 10 simulated-second intervals; report candidate, supported, and rejected pair counts. User#500 removes the translation numeric rejection limit; preserve measured translation, supported/rejected pair coverage, and existing rotation comparison.

raw_vio_velocity_error.method: N13 diagnostic only; neither numeric breaches nor missing diagnostic coverage determine functional PASS/FAIL. Historical measurement method: Raw VINS world-frame velocity versus centered 0.2 simulated-second truth IMU velocity; no extrapolation; never interpret these as commanded-speed caps.

raw_map_surface_geometry.method: N13 diagnostic only; neither numeric breaches nor missing diagnostic coverage determine functional PASS/FAIL. Historical measurement method: Use one identity-bound snapshot containing the raw occupancy array and separate inflated mask. Compare occupied voxel centers with the injected SDF surface offline, and report support per observed face; unobserved faces remain explicitly unsupported and are not inferred from missing points. Snapshot identity, source-time coverage, array shape/order and hashes are required. Live point queries remain optional diagnostics and are not repeatedly required when the raw/inflated snapshot already provides the relevant map evidence. User#508: surface-center error is diagnostic without a numeric rejection limit; retain finite observed values and identity/source support. Actual body clearance and classification thresholds are unchanged.

raw_map_classification.method: N13 diagnostic only; neither numeric breaches nor missing diagnostic coverage determine functional PASS/FAIL. Historical measurement method: Report visible-free, surface, and truth-occluded ROI counts separately. Unknown remains its own class. This is a diagnostic semantic check, not a raw-known-free flight gate.

native_behavior.source: current EGO upstream parameter; retain the native behavior and do not duplicate it as a project-local gate

map_source_and_update_age.method: N13 diagnostic only; neither numeric breaches nor missing diagnostic coverage determine functional PASS/FAIL. Historical measurement method: Keep source, fusion/update, response/receipt stamps separate; report maximum samples and gaps. These offline candidate values do not trigger launch, cancellation, or landing.

ego_tracking_error.method: N13 diagnostic only; neither numeric breaches nor missing diagnostic coverage determine functional PASS/FAIL. Historical measurement method: User#520 removes the minimum body-clearance numeric comparison. Keep finite actual body/spline/interval clearance measurements, run/source identities, complete 4ms physics/command pairing and zero prohibited contact. No replacement zero-metre acceptance threshold and no runtime control gate.

ego_tracking_clearance_budget.method: N13 diagnostic only; neither numeric breaches nor missing diagnostic coverage determine functional PASS/FAIL. Historical measurement method: User#520 removes the minimum body-clearance numeric comparison. Keep finite actual body/spline/interval clearance measurements, run/source identities, complete 4ms physics/command pairing and zero prohibited contact. No replacement zero-metre acceptance threshold and no runtime control gate.

full_body_clearance_and_contact.method: Recompute genuine sensor contacts against model manifest and phase timeline; require complete same-run contact observation through safe terminal and independently read-back normal landed/disarmed/control-disabled terminal. Full physics-step geometry remains diagnostic, without a numeric clearance limit.

dynamic_replanning.method: N13 diagnostic only; neither numeric breaches nor missing diagnostic coverage determine functional PASS/FAIL. Historical measurement method: User#520 removes the minimum body-clearance numeric comparison. Keep finite actual body/spline/interval clearance measurements, run/source identities, complete 4ms physics/command pairing and zero prohibited contact. No replacement zero-metre acceptance threshold and no runtime control gate. Replan deadline uses the previously active spline reaching the body collision boundary with zero ADDITIONAL clearance margin; the first new post-observation replacement is selected without a clearance-margin filter. Timing, actual contact and observation/support requirements remain.

fault_exit_to_terminal_px4_state.method: Derive detection and terminal timing from native mechanisms and one current-version calibration per unsupported class; do not substitute a request to stop or a bridge LAND command for independent PX4 state readback.
fault_exit_to_terminal_px4_state.scope_note: Not required for current N10.3 normal-navigation calibration. This exclusion does not qualify fault response or erase failures.

resource_and_queue_behavior.capacity_source: identity-bound run cgroup counters and same-workspace host capacity observation; freeze both at N10.7
resource_and_queue_behavior.unknown_queue_capacity_policy: Report VINS estimator queue capacity as unknown because upstream source is unbounded; do not infer a cap from observed high-water. N16 separately evaluates 600 simulated seconds for sustained growth.
resource_and_queue_behavior.method: N13 diagnostic only; neither numeric breaches nor missing diagnostic coverage determine functional PASS/FAIL. Historical measurement method: Bind CPU and memory comparison limits to cgroup quota or host capacity. Require zero cgroup throttling/OOM and complete one-second observation with no gap over two sample periods. Check finite mapping depth against its configured cap; report drops alongside map freshness and realized clearance. For VINS, record current-depth trend and process high-water but keep capacity explicitly unknown. RTF, CPU, memory, PID, and queue values are offline-only; no runtime refusal is added. N16 remains the separate 600 simulated-second duration test. Revision9 uses native pending feature work and source horizons. Raw IMU/feature current counts, slopes and process high-water remain diagnostics. Lag budget0.2s reserves half the native0.4s EGO input timeout; at30Hz stereo/stride2 processing this permits at most2 waiting features behind the current item. Missing native fields are INSUFFICIENT; stale post-consumption IMU or horizon/backlog violations FAIL. Offline only.

observer_identity_binding.method: Bind core truth, alignment, planner, bridge and contact observations to one run/runtime/goal/epoch/map identity. Resource, legacy injection and raw payload captures are optional diagnostics. Actual map/replan evidence is separately required by the pending N13 scene protocol.

n13_scene_navigation.method: Recompute each staggered obstacle actual/reference bypass and pre-passage map support; require executed matching replacement trajectories and multiple observed map updates. Bind actual project geometry and evaluator SHA-256 to release. Missing inputs are INSUFFICIENT.

required_core: unique control owner and no online truth
same epoch through each independent mission
actual matching executed replanning and map updates
per-obstacle raw/inflated pre-crossing support and actual/reference bypass where applicable
zero prohibited contacts and independent normal terminal
